Actors Nana Patekar and Madhu Kambikar Pass Away

Veteran actor Nana Patekar passed away, followed three days later by Madhu Kambikar, who played his mother in a Marathi film. Four days after Patekar's death, a prayer meet was held where film stars remembered him with tearful tributes, with videos of the event circulating.
